title: Chicken Wrap
subtitle: Grilled chicken in a flour tortilla with salad and tzatziki
excerpt: Seasoned grilled chicken breast, crisp lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and a generous spoonful of Greek yoghurt dressing, all wrapped in a warm flour tortilla. A simple lunch or light supper.

recipe.sourceNotes: The chicken wrap became a staple of British high-street cafes and supermarket meal deals during the late 1990s and 2000s, inspired loosely by Middle Eastern flatbread wraps and Tex-Mex burritos. It is one of the most popular lunch options in Britain. The home version is better than any packaged version: warm the tortilla, use well-seasoned chicken, and fill it generously with fresh salad ingredients.

recipeTools.notes: Or a non-stick frying pan for the chicken.

content.text: Slice the chicken breast in half horizontally to make two thinner pieces: these cook more quickly and evenly than thick breasts. Season generously. The chicken is cooked when the juices run clear and the interior is no longer pink. Rest for 2 minutes before slicing.
Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally. Rub with olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Mix the Greek yoghurt, garlic, and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Heat a griddle pan or frying pan over high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until cooked through with clear juices. Rest for 2 minutes, then slice.
Warm each tortilla in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Spread the yoghurt dressing over each tortilla. Layer on the lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and sliced chicken. Roll tightly. Cut in half and serve.
